original_ai_output.title_zh: 萨赫勒地区敌对圣战组织冲突加剧，JNIM与伊斯兰国交火
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 萨赫勒地区敌对圣战派系近期在布基纳法索、马里和尼日尔交界地带发生前所未有规模的冲突。伊斯兰国萨赫勒省声称四天前杀害了400多名与基地组织有关联的JNIM武装分子。该消息目前为单一来源，尚未获得独立证实。

location.raw_text: borderlands spanning Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger

key_facts.fact: 萨赫勒地区敌对圣战派系近期发生前所未有规模的冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Jihadists from rival Al-Qaeda and Islamic State factions in the Sahel have clashed recently on an unprecedented scale in the borderlands spanning Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger

key_facts.fact: 伊斯兰国萨赫勒省声称杀害400多名JNIM武装分子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On Monday, the Islamic State in the Sahel Province said it had killed more than 400 fighters from the al-Qaeda-linked JNIM four days earlier.

key_facts.fact: 冲突发生在布基纳法索、马里和尼日尔交界地带
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in the borderlands spanning Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger
